## Problem Statement

What limitation or missing capability does this feature address? (e.g. "There is no way to…")

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature and how it would work from a user's perspective.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you have considered, and why you ruled them out.

## Scope Check

Does this feature fit the project's scope (a production-grade C++ terminal editor with no external dependencies)?

- [ ] Yes — it is a terminal-editor concern
- [ ] Not sure — please advise

## Additional Context

Any mockups, references, or related issues that provide useful context.
